messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to onboard Ceres-2.1 into the model catalog tonight (quiet window 02:00-03:00 PT). Can people confirm owners for: pinning the model alias, running the smoke prompts, and rollback readiness?
liam: I can own the alias pin + catalog entry. Will drop a PR in ~30m.
sophie: I can take smoke tests and the prompt set. What traffic percentage for canary?
maya: thanks @liam. For canary let's do 5% for 30m, then 25% for 20m if green, then full. That matches our standard gradually-increase policy.
arjun: I'll standby for rollback readiness and infra checks. If anything in the canary fails I can trigger automatic fallback.
liam: PR opened: https://git.company/redwood/catalog/pulls/412 — includes metadata, perf tags, and quant profile. PTAL @sophie @arjun
sophie: quick question on the smoke set — do we include the prompt that exercises streaming + function-calling? want to exercise KV cache warmup too.
maya: yes include a short streaming chat with a function call and a long-context doc summarization to warm KV. I'll paste the smoke prompts below.
maya: ```
# smoke_prompts.yaml
- name: streaming_function_call
  input: "Give me a 2-step plan and return as json, call func summarize_plan()"
- name: long_context_summary
  input: "Summarize the attached 8k token doc and list 3 action items"
```
liam: config for pinning I used in the catalog PR: ```
{
  "model_alias": "ceres:stable",
  "version": "ceres-2.1",
  "pin_policy": "gradual",
  "canary_percent": 5
}
```
sophie: running the smoke locally now. quick smoke command: `tools/smoke/run --model ceres-2.1 --set smoke_prompts.yaml --timeout 3m`
sophie: smoke run output snippet: ```
[INFO] running streaming_function_call... OK (stream chunk latency 80ms)
[INFO] running long_context_summary... OK (tokens processed 8200)
[WARN] kv-cache-warmup took 1.2s — acceptable
```
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: preflight passed (capacity: ok, quant-profile: verified), reserve slot 3 in pool-dedicated-us-west-2.
arjun: all good from infra side. I verified fallback alias exists and model variant ceres-2.0 is pinned as fallback. Rollback playbook ready: `ops/rollbacks/ceres-rollback.md`
maya: thanks. Two small asks before kickoff: 1) @liam can you add the canary routing policy to the PR comment, 2) @sophie please attach the smoke logs to the PR.
liam: added routing policy and canary windows in PR comment.
sophie: uploaded smoke logs to PR and also pasted results in #eng-sre for visibility.
maya: cool. We'll target 02:10 PT start for the canary. I'll trigger the pin and post status. If no major errors by 02:45 we'll ramp to 25%. Everyone monitor channels, I'll post updates here.
liam: noted, I'll be on call for alias ops.
arjun: I'll monitor infra metrics and set alert thresholds to tighter margins for the first 30m.
sophie: I'll keep a small prompt set running continuously during the ramp.
deploy-bot: scheduled pin job queued: job_id=ceres-pin-3070012345; ETA 02:10 PT. Logs will stream to infra-logs/ceres/3070012345.log
maya: thanks all — quick ping if anyone can't make the window. Otherwise I'll proceed and update when canary starts. :thumbsup:
